RACE3D

A car built from springs, dampers, a Pacejka-style tyre model and a torque curve on top of a Rapier rigid body. Nothing about the handling is scripted. Drive it yourself — or sit in the pit wall and watch the field race AI vs AI from the broadcast cameras. Or step into KOTA: drive car #1 through a grid of city streets shared with ten autonomous cars — lane keeping, traffic lights, turn signals and all.
